newsitem.title: USA: Core sets buy, sees Q1 meeting estimate.
newsitem.headline: Core sets buy, sees Q1 meeting estimate.

text.p: Core Laboratories NV said in a statement on Thursday that it would buy Saybolt International BV for $67 million in cash and the assumption of $5.5 million in net debt.
Core also said that it expects first quarter 1997 operational earnings at or exceeding analysts' estimates of $0.16 per share.
Saybolt, a privately held company, had 1996 revenues of $100 million and provides analytical and field services used to characterize crude oil and its derivatives.

"We will be able to leverage Saybolt's significant presence and operating experience in the Commonwealth of Independent States to meet the increasing demand for petroleum reservoir description and production management services," said Core's chief executive David Demshur.
The company said this will be especially applicable in the Caspian Sea.
